# Chronological Overview

| Phase | Event |
|---|---|
| Cosmic Early Age | Era exists as the physical center. Sol and Yol, opposing yet connected beings, form a protective barrier around the planet. |
| Emergence of the Atea | Ten Worldkeepers become active as parts and overseers of Era. Their exact origin remains unresolved. |
| Formation of Hera | Countless soul spaces, entities, and domains of power arise within the multidimensional shard realm. |
| Rise of the Major Entities | Ten exceptionally powerful Ether Entities shape large parts of Hera. Jator controls the domain of Tatok. |
| Soul Trade and Indirect Influence | Because Sol and Yol prevent direct access, entities affect Era through pacts, traders, corruption, and the redirection of souls. |
| Pact of Jator and Semm | Jator and Semm develop a Constructed World intended to produce powerful heroic souls. |
| Zehsen's Intervention | Zehsen introduces a Talisman into the system without openly attacking the Constructed World. |
| The Hero's Life on Era | The future hero lives on Era and enters into a pact. The details remain undefined. |
| Death and Redirection | The hero dies; his soul does not enter the normal cycle, but is instead taken to Tatok. |
| Beginning of the Game | The hero awakens in the Hero's Chamber, believes himself to be alive, and receives a mission and tools. |
| Journey of Restoration | Regions, nature, souls, inhabitants, cities, memories, and abilities return in stages. |
| Revelation | The Talisman deciphers the truth that the rescued world is an artificial system for cultivating souls. |
| Endgame Return | The hero revisits the liberated worlds and gathers Soul Energy. |
| Escape from the Constructed World | Using the power he has gathered, he leaves Tatok's inner region. |
| Three World Passages | Three enemy-held transitional spaces lead to Jator. |
| Base Game Finale | Jator is defeated. An open portal leads to Semm, who is also defeated. Both remain fundamentally existent as Ether Entities. |
| Expansion | The hero fights the remaining major entities and ultimately becomes an Ether Entity himself. |
| Open Ending | Because of his unusual origin, he can return physically to Era. His later role is left untold. |
